Die Glückspille (Wandkunst)

https://makerworld.com/de/models/3173421-the-happy-pill-wall-art#profileId-3588091

Boost Mea happy pill to fix all your problems. A ginormous happy pill to hang on your wall (:

This model is two different pieces that print separately & WILL need to be superglued together, however there is a key to make sure that everything lines up properly and evenly. 

Two keyholes on the back side of the model allow for easy hanging with either nails or thumbtacks! 

 

The text can be modified in bambu studio to say whatever you like, would love to see some different variations of this! 

 

If you enjoy my model please give me a boost!

Thank you very much 

-K0nur

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: AMS VERSION 
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 10%
- Filament: PLA (#F72323), PLA (#000000), PLA (#FFFFFF)
